msg: In the experiment, you will have a choice of different gnomes.  A few of the gnomes will take you to one forest with a basket, whilst another selection will take you to a separate forest with a different coloured basket.  There are only two forests.The task is to find the correct spot where the mushrooms are.  A specific gnome will take you to the mushrooms whilst others won't.  The best thing to do is to choose specific gnomes, once you find mushrooms, and then sticking to your decisions.  Once you start to change, it will likely mess with either the amount or whether you get any.Once finding a specific colour gnome that works, try to stick to that gnome colour.  The speed is an issue but that will becoming easier as the game goes along.  The variation of the gnomes will change but the specific colours will show up.  This is a long description so I am trying to find other things that may help.  Take advantage of the breaks in between.  Make sure to stay focussed and be aware of the time limits.  It can come around quickly and will not give you the points if time runs out.
